title: Among patients admitted to the hospital who show signs of immune dysregulat
question: Among patients admitted to the hospital who show signs of immune dysregulation—defined as having either abnormally low or high IgM levels (IGM < 50 or IGM > 350)—how many also exhibited elevated total cholesterol (T-CHO ≥ 220) and tested negative for coagulation abnormality (KCT = '-') in their examinations?

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1."XCL_058")
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1."XCL_058" = T2."XCL_001"
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1."XCL_058" = T3."XCL_014"
WHERE T2."XCL_013" > 0
  AND (T3."XCL_044" < 50 OR T3."XCL_044" > 350)
  AND T3."XCL_026" >= 220
  AND T2."XCL_009" = '-'
